title: Particle Trajectories Beneath Fully Nonlinear Waves Generated by Horizontal Seabed Motion
summary: We investigate fully nonlinear water waves and fluid-particle dynamics generated by the horizontal motion of a seabed obstacle with prescribed time-dependent velocity. The governing equations are the full Euler equations, formulated in a time-dependent conformal domain that simultaneously maps the moving free surface and seabed onto fixed boundaries. The main contribution of this work is a Lagrangian formulation for computing particle trajectories in the resulting genuinely unsteady conformal domain.
